literal: The fierce flood of passion carries away indeed, along with modesty, the raft called good strength of character.
translation: The fierce flood of desire sweeps away the raft of modesty and strength of character.
modern: காமம் என்னும் கடுமையான வெள்ளம், நாணமும் நல்ல மனவலிமையும் ஆகிய தெப்பத்தை அடித்துச் சென்றுவிடுகிறது.
explanation: This couplet uses a vivid metaphor to describe the overwhelming power of desire. The poet compares intense love or passion to a fierce, raging flood (கடும்புனல்). To survive this flood, a person relies on a raft (புணை) constructed of modesty (நாண்) and strong self-control or dignity (ஆண்மை). However, the torrent of passion is so powerful that it sweeps away even this protective raft, leaving the individual helpless against their desires.
